fragment_extraction.mock_seam_strategy: No trait-based mocks needed: the C source has no I/O/network/filesystem boundaries, and the only 'environment' dependency (libc rand()) is already abstracted behind common::randrange/normal_rand/rand::Rng, which the skeleton does not parametrize with an injectable RNG. Testable seams are therefore: (1) pure-function input->output assertions for common/polynomial/matrix(non-random parts)/channel; (2) property-based invariant checks (run-many-times) for randomized matrix transforms and aces_internal generators; (3) one end-to-end regression test in aces.rs translated from the C README worked example. All Part-B fragments are marked needs-new-test since c-source/tests/ was removed as the held-out oracle basis.

skeleton.part_a_seam: Every scaffold function/method body left as unimplemented!() with its exact declared signature (name, params, return type, pub visibility) preserved verbatim from .scaffold; no logic added.
skeleton.part_b_seam: A #[cfg(test)] mod tests { use super::*; ... } block appended to the bottom of each of the 6 implementation files (common.rs, matrix.rs, polynomial.rs, channel.rs, aces_internal.rs, aces.rs). Each test is #[ignore = "needs-new-test: ..."] with an unimplemented!() body and a doc comment naming the C invariant/behavior it must assert once the Translator fills in real logic -- this keeps cargo test --lib passing today (ignored tests are skipped) while recording the exact test surface the Translator must implement per milestone.
skeleton.no_new_public_items: No new public types/traits were added beyond what .scaffold already declares; error.rs (AcesError/Result) is untouched as it is already a fixed, fully-specified API.
skeleton.build_check_result: OK (crate builds; 127 warning(s) -- all unused-variable/unimplemented-related, none are errors)
skeleton.unit_test_result: OK (no agent-written tests yet -- all new tests are #[ignore]d stubs pending Translator implementation)

implementation_plan.title: error + common
implementation_plan.goal: Implement AcesError/Result (already fixed, no work) and all of common.rs: gcd, xgcd, are_coprime, randinverse, randrange, normal_rand, max, min, clamp.
steps_part_a: src/common.rs:gcd -- Euclidean subtraction loop (while x != y) exactly as Common.c.
src/common.rs:xgcd -- extended Euclidean algorithm, i64 Bezout coefficients as Common.c.
src/common.rs:are_coprime -- gcd(x,y) == 1, exposed as bool per skeleton (C's !(gcd>1)).
src/common.rs:randinverse -- sample a in [2,value-1] via randrange until coprime, then xgcd-derive inverse in [1,value).
src/common.rs:randrange -- rand::Rng::random_range(lower..=upper), inclusive bounds per Common.c's rand()%(upper-lower+1)+lower.
src/common.rs:normal_rand -- Box-Muller transform with rand::Rng uniforms + f64::ln/sqrt/cos, matching Common.c's rand_val()/PI constant.
src/common.rs:max/min/clamp -- direct u64 comparisons per Common.h's static inline versions.
steps_part_b: src/common.rs:tests::gcd_matches_known_values -- un-ignore, assert gcd(48,18)==6 and other hand-picked C-doc-derived cases.
src/common.rs:tests::xgcd_satisfies_bezout_identity -- assert gcd == a*x + b*y for several (x,y) pairs.
src/common.rs:tests::are_coprime_matches_gcd_equals_one -- table-driven boolean checks.
src/common.rs:tests::randinverse_produces_valid_modular_inverse -- property test over many iterations: 1<=a<value, a*inv % value == 1.
src/common.rs:tests::randrange_stays_within_inclusive_bounds -- property test over many iterations, assert lower<=v<=upper including lower==upper edge case.
src/common.rs:tests::normal_rand_produces_finite_values -- assert .is_finite() over many samples.
src/common.rs:tests::max_min_clamp_boundary_behavior -- equal-args ties, value below/above/within range.

implementation_plan.title: matrix
implementation_plan.goal: Implement Matrix2D/Matrix3D and matrix2d_multiply, swap_transform, linear_mix_transform, scale_transform, matrix2d_eye, fill_random_invertible_pairs.
steps_part_a: src/matrix.rs:Matrix2D::new/row/row_mut/get/set -- Vec-backed dim*dim storage, Option/Result-returning bounds-checked accessors replacing C's unchecked static-inline pointer math.
src/matrix.rs:Matrix3D::new/get_mut -- Vec<Matrix2D> replacing the C data+size pair; get_mut replaces the free matrix3d_get.
src/matrix.rs:matrix2d_multiply -- naive triple loop mod-q product per Matrix.c, using wrapping_mul/wrapping_add for the u64*u64 accumulation.
src/matrix.rs:swap_transform -- random row/col swap between m and invm via common::randrange, mirroring Matrix.c's memcpy-based row swap.
src/matrix.rs:linear_mix_transform -- random column mix with mod-q scale factor per Matrix.c.
src/matrix.rs:scale_transform -- random scale via common::randinverse applied to every element of m and invm.
src/matrix.rs:matrix2d_eye -- zero then set diagonal to 1.

src/matrix.rs:fill_random_invertible_pairs -- matrix2d_eye both matrices then apply `iterations` random transforms selected via common::randrange(0,2), internal dispatch table (no public Transformer type).
steps_part_b: src/matrix.rs:tests::matrix2d_accessors_respect_bounds -- assert None for out-of-range row/col, Some/Ok for in-range.
src/matrix.rs:tests::matrix2d_multiply_matches_naive_product -- small hand-built matrices, compare against manually computed mod-q product.
src/matrix.rs:tests::matrix2d_eye_is_identity -- assert diagonal==1, off-diagonal==0.
src/matrix.rs:tests::swap_transform_preserves_inverse_invariant -- start from eye pair, apply transform N times, assert m*invm % q == I each time (property test).
src/matrix.rs:tests::linear_mix_transform_preserves_inverse_invariant -- same invariant, N trials.
src/matrix.rs:tests::scale_transform_preserves_inverse_invariant -- same invariant, N trials.
src/matrix.rs:tests::fill_random_invertible_pairs_yields_valid_pair -- after 600-like iterations, assert m*invm % q == I.

implementation_plan.title: polynomial
implementation_plan.goal: Implement Polynomial/PolyArray and all methods: degree, set_zero, coef_sum, fit, add, sub, mul, lshift, poly_mod, sub_scaler, add_scaler.
steps_part_a: src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::new/PolyArray::new -- direct Vec ownership, replacing malloc-based get_polynomial/get_polyarray/set_polynomial/poly_free.
src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::degree -- MSB-first: size-1-i for first nonzero coeffs[i], 0 for size==0/all-zero, per Polynomial.c's poly_degree.
src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::set_zero -- fill coeffs with 0.
src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::coef_sum -- sum all coeffs as i64, 0 for empty, matching coef_sum's early-return.
src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::fit -- strip leading (low-index) zero run using degree(), reduce remaining coeffs mod (as u64 cast back to i64), matching poly_fit's idx computation and truncation.

src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::add/sub -- Err on size mismatch vs result capacity or mod==0 (poly_add/poly_sub's explicit `mod == 0` check preserved); zero-pad shorter operand at the low-index end when sizes differ.
src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::mul -- convolution accumulate then fit(), preserving poly_mul's res_deg offset arithmetic and wrapping_mul on i64 products mod q.
src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::lshift -- Err if divisor's leading coeff != 1 or degree1<degree2; else per-coeff subtract-and-correct-sign (`res<0 -> res+mod`) exactly as poly_lshift, then fit().
src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::poly_mod -- repeatedly call lshift on self until it errs (degree1<degree2), in place, per poly_mod's while loop.
src/polynomial.rs:Polynomial::sub_scaler/add_scaler -- per-coefficient (coeff -/+ scaler) % mod, matching C's truncating-toward-zero % semantics with sign correction where needed.
steps_part_b: src/polynomial.rs:tests::degree_matches_msb_first_convention -- hand-built coeffs arrays, assert degree for various leading-zero-run lengths, including size==0.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::coef_sum_matches_hand_computed_example -- small fixed coeffs, assert sum.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::set_zero_zeroes_all_coefficients -- assert all-zero after call.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::fit_strips_leading_zero_coefficients -- polynomial with leading zeros, assert resulting coeffs/len match poly_fit semantics.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::add_matches_hand_computed_example -- same-size and size-mismatched operands, assert zero-padded mod-q sum.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::sub_matches_hand_computed_example -- same, for subtraction including negative-result sign correction.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::mul_matches_hand_computed_example -- small polynomials, assert convolution result against hand computation.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::lshift_errs_when_divisor_leading_coeff_is_not_one -- divisor with coeffs[0]!=1 -> Err.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::poly_mod_reduces_below_divisor_degree -- assert resulting degree < divisor degree after poly_mod.
src/polynomial.rs:tests::sub_scaler_applies_to_every_coefficient / add_scaler_applies_to_every_coefficient -- per-element assertions.

implementation_plan.title: channel
implementation_plan.goal: Implement Channel::new/Channel::init and Parameters (already just data).
steps_part_a: src/channel.rs:Channel::new -- unconditional constructor {p,q,w}, no validation (mirrors the plain field-assignment portion of init_channel).

src/channel.rs:Channel::init -- replicate C's actual behavior: if p^2 < q && are_coprime(p,q), keep q; else q = (p+1)^2 (both branches return Ok(Self{..}), never Err, per design note 3.4 overriding the skeleton's paraphrased doc comment).
steps_part_b: src/channel.rs:tests::init_keeps_q_when_p_squared_less_than_q_and_coprime -- choose p,q,w hitting the kept-as-is branch, assert returned q unchanged.
src/channel.rs:tests::init_corrects_q_to_p_plus_one_squared_when_condition_fails -- choose p,q,w failing p^2<q or coprimality, assert q==(p+1)^2.

implementation_plan.title: aces_internal
implementation_plan.goal: Implement generate_error, generate_vanisher, generate_linear, generate_u, generate_secret, generate_f0, generate_f1.
steps_part_a: src/aces_internal.rs:generate_error -- sample rm coeffs via randrange(0,q), then shift-correct the last coefficient so coef_sum(rm) % q == message, per Aces-internal.c.

src/aces_internal.rs:generate_vanisher -- sample internal k in {0,1} (EPROB=0.5 threshold), sample e coeffs, shift-correct last coeff so coef_sum(e) % q relates to p*k; k itself is not returned (skeleton drops it, confirmed unused by all callers).
src/aces_internal.rs:generate_linear -- sample internal k in [0,p], sample b coeffs, shift-correct last coeff so coef_sum(b) % q relates to k.

src/aces_internal.rs:generate_u -- build length dim+1 polynomial: coeffs[0]=1, randomized nonzero/zero run pattern using randrange + normal_rand + clamp exactly as Aces-internal.c, last coeff = q - coef_sum(u).

src/aces_internal.rs:generate_secret -- build dim x dim invertible pair via matrix::fill_random_invertible_pairs, derive secret.polies[i] from invm columns, derive lambda tensor via poly_mul + poly_mod + matrix2d_multiply composition per Aces-internal.c's nested loop.
src/aces_internal.rs:generate_f0 -- fill each f0.polies[i] with randrange(0,q-1) samples sized to each polynomial's own existing length.

src/aces_internal.rs:generate_f1 -- compute sum(f0_i * x_i) mod u via poly_mul/poly_add/poly_mod, then copy the low-order f1.coeffs.len() entries into f1 (Rust replacement for C's pointer-shift truncation).
steps_part_b: src/aces_internal.rs:tests::generate_error_encodes_message_in_coef_sum -- assert coef_sum(rm) % q == message for several q/message values.
src/aces_internal.rs:tests::generate_vanisher_coef_sum_is_multiple_of_p_mod_q -- assert coef_sum(e) % q is congruent to 0 or p (property test, many trials since k is internal/random).
src/aces_internal.rs:tests::generate_linear_coef_sum_is_within_p_mod_q -- assert coef_sum(b) % q in [0,p] range across trials.
src/aces_internal.rs:tests::generate_u_has_correct_shape_and_coef_sum -- assert len==dim+1, coeffs[0]==1, coef_sum(u)==q.

src/aces_internal.rs:tests::generate_secret_derives_consistent_secret_and_lambda -- assert secret has dim polynomials, lambda has dim matrices, and the algebraic relation from Aces-internal.c's doc comment holds for at least one (i,j).
src/aces_internal.rs:tests::generate_f0_samples_within_bounds -- assert every sampled coeff is in [0,q-1].
src/aces_internal.rs:tests::generate_f1_matches_reduced_sum_of_products -- build small f0/x/u fixtures, assert f1 equals the independently-computed reduced sum.

implementation_plan.title: aces
implementation_plan.goal: Implement PublicKey/PrivateKey/SharedInfo/Aces/CipherMessage plumbing, set_aces, init_aces, aces_encrypt, aces_decrypt, aces_add, aces_mul (stub), aces_refresh.
steps_part_a: src/aces.rs:set_aces -- size-check mem.len() against an equivalent required-capacity computation (proxy for C's byte-arena check), then construct zeroed Vec-backed u (dim+1), lambda (dim x dim x dim), x/f0 (dim polynomials of size dim), f1 (size dim) directly -- no raw pointer slicing into mem.
src/aces.rs:init_aces -- wire Channel::init -> aces_internal::generate_u -> generate_secret -> generate_f0 -> generate_f1 in that order, matching Aces.c's init_aces.
src/aces.rs:aces_encrypt -- Err if message.len()>1; else generate r_m/e/b via aces_internal, compute c1[i]=poly_mod(b*f0[i],u) per component, c2=poly_mod((f1+e)*b + r_m, u), level=channel.p.
src/aces.rs:aces_decrypt -- Err if result.len()>1 (mirroring C's size>1 guard on the analogous side); accumulate sum(c1[i]*x[i]) fitted, subtract from c2, result[0] = (coef_sum % q) % p.
src/aces.rs:aces_add -- per-component c1 add + poly_mod(u), c2 add + poly_mod(u), level=a.level+b.level.
src/aces.rs:aces_mul -- no-op Ok(()), result left untouched, matching C's TODO stub exactly (do not implement real homomorphic multiplication).
src/aces.rs:aces_refresh -- c2 = sub_scaler(c2, k*p, q); level = level.wrapping_sub(k) to preserve C's silent u64 underflow wraparound.
steps_part_b: src/aces.rs:tests::set_aces_shapes_buffers_correctly -- assert u.len()==dim+1, lambda.data.len()==dim (each dim x dim), x/f0 have dim polys of len dim, f1.len()==dim.
src/aces.rs:tests::set_aces_errs_on_undersized_mem -- pass a too-small mem slice, assert Err.
src/aces.rs:tests::init_aces_wires_all_key_material -- after init_aces, assert channel/u/secret/f0/f1 are all populated with the expected shapes.
src/aces.rs:tests::encrypt_add_decrypt_round_trip_matches_readme_example -- translate the C README example verbatim: p=2,q=33,dim=D, encrypt 4 and 3, aces_add, decrypt, assert result == (4+3)%2.
src/aces.rs:tests::encrypt_decrypt_errs_when_message_len_exceeds_one -- message.len()==2 -> Err from aces_encrypt; oversized result slice -> Err from aces_decrypt.
src/aces.rs:tests::aces_add_sums_levels_and_reduces_mod_u -- assert result.level == a.level + b.level and c1/c2 degrees stay reduced mod u.
src/aces.rs:tests::aces_mul_is_a_no_op_matching_c_stub -- call aces_mul on a mutated `result` sentinel, assert it is unchanged and Ok(()) is returned.
src/aces.rs:tests::aces_refresh_subtracts_k_times_p_and_decrements_level -- assert level decreases by k (including a wrapping-underflow case with k>level).
